note: privaty-unkind-maid (Privaty: Unkind Maid, aka pum) — Electric SG Attacker, Burst III (cd 40s), ammo 9 / reloadFrames 141 / hitsPerShot 10 pellets / normalMult 182.1. A pellet-counter kit; ALL FIVE load-bearing lines modeled. SKILL1 'Activates when hitting the target with 30 pellets → 2 enemies nearest crosshair → 202.84% final ATK' = hitCount count:30 → enemy → flatDamage 202.84 noRange. The engine hit counter adds hitsPerShot (=10) per trigger PULL (sim.ts `firePull()`, the `hitCounters` increment), so '30 pellets' = every 3rd pull, firing REPEATEDLY (cumulative). The counter counts FIRED pellets (10/pull regardless of landing); the kit reads 'hitting with 30 pellets' = LANDED — at single-boss focus-band landing ~9/10 the two are near-equivalent (⚑1, banded cadence). The '2 enemies nearest the crosshair' collapses to the lone boss on the partless single-boss basis (caveat). Rider conventions: crit-on at sheet rate (engine flatDamage default), NO core (no 'core strike' text), noRange (skill riders never take the +30% range major), FB-by-timing (noFb NOT set). SKILL2 line 1 '≥5 pellets hit with a single normal attack → self → Reload Speed ▲20.88% for 2s' = shotFired → self → reloadSpeedPct 20.88 / 2s. The per-shot '≥5 pellets' landing gate has NO engine primitive and is DROPPED — assumed satisfied: a single boss at the focus band lands ~9/10 pellets, well over 5, and the 2s window refreshed every ~0.67s shot gives ~100% uptime regardless, so the gate is not load-bearing (⚑2). Reload Speed IS damage-bearing (reloadFrames 141 on a 9-shell mag gates shots fired) — NOT a defensive skip. SKILL2 line 2 '30 pellet hits during Full Burst → self → Reload 1 round + ATK ▲11.22% ×5 / 2s' = hitCount count:30 + fbGate:'inFb' → self → instantReload fraction 0.1111 (≈1/9 = ONE shell of the 9-shell mag, NOT a full refill) + buff atkPct 11.22 maxStacks 5 / 2s. fbGate:'inFb' (sim.ts `blockGatesPass()`) gates the firing to Full Burst windows — the velvet/modernia precedent for 'N hits during Full Burst' procs. The counter itself still cycles ungated (sim.ts `firePull()`, the `hitCounters` threshold consume consumes the threshold whether or not the gated block applies), so there is no banked-burst at FB entry; it fires every ~3rd pull WHILE in FB and ~never outside (⚑3: the kit intends the counter to accrue only in-FB hits, the engine accrues always — a small boundary over-accrual, same documented approximation as modernia S2b). BURST line 1 'self → Attack damage ▲10.56% + Critical Damage ▲88.17% for 10s' = burstCast → self → attackDamagePct 10.56 / 10s + critDamagePct 88.17 / 10s (self-scoped; fires on HER OWN cast, NOT fullBurstEnter — so on rotations a different B3 carries, these do NOT apply). BURST line 2 'all enemies → 1066.66% final ATK Burst Skill damage' = burstCast → enemy → flatDamage 1066.66 (single boss = the one target; burst-cast instant damage is auto-FB-exempt — the cast lands before the FB window opens; crit-on at sheet rate). NO `ignored` blocks; unmodeled arrays genuinely empty. ⚑ NEEDS-MEASUREMENT: (1) S1 fired-vs-landed pellet cadence [low]: estimate = near-equivalent at ~9/10 focus-band landing; recipe = per-shot landed-pellet count in a pum focus video (cadence stretches if landing < 10/shot). (2) S2a ≥5-pellet per-shot gate [dropped, low]: estimate = always-satisfied at single-boss landing; recipe = per-shot landed-pellet count at the recorded band (gate bites only at far band / <5 landing). (3) S2b counter now countScope:'gated' (2026-08-16 triage): the kit reads 'hitting 30 times with pellets during Full Burst', scoping the COUNTING to FB — the counter accrues only in-FB pellet hits and resets per FB window. Prior reading accrued always (small boundary over-accrual into FB-entry firings); the gated reading is now exact. (4) CADENCE TUPLE [mandatory, datamine-unreliable]: pullsPerSec (SG class default ~1.5) + reloadFrames 141 (datamine) + rolling-reload; recipe = rounds/min + reload gap from any pum focus video. TIER 2 (pellet-counter cadence + FB-gated counter + round-count reload + stack mechanic). Cross-family: S2b claude-fable-5 independently re-derived all five lines FAITHFUL and surfaced the fbGate:'inFb' encoding for S2b (the driver's first draft had it UNMODELED — corrected). Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-01.
